# a11y-pcf

> Phase 0 skeleton — guide content and audit support land in Phase 5 / v2 (see `docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md`, step 5.2). Until then, answer PCF accessibility questions from general WCAG/ARIA knowledge and say that automated PCF auditing is not yet available in this plugin version.

Planned coverage: `ControlManifest.Input.xml` accessible-name rules, keyboard handlers for canvas-drawn controls, Dataverse form XML label/description gaps, SC 4.1.2 name/role/value for custom controls.
